commands.name: task:add
commands.syntax: --title TEXT --creator ID --responsible ID [--project ID --deadline ISO8601 --description TEXT | --description-file PATH|-] [--fields JSON | --fields-file PATH|-]
commands.note: Требуются title, creatorId, responsibleId. Критерии приёмки/источник/клиентский контекст можно передать текстом описания; структурированная модель отдельно. Обычные флаги разрешены вместе; advanced --fields/--fields-file является отдельным режимом без смешивания с полевыми флагами согласно cli-experience. Title/creator/responsible обязательны и в итоговом advanced вводе.
commands.mvp_reason: Retained under consideration after explicit exclusions; all existing API and lifecycle gates still apply.

commands.name: task:list
commands.syntax: [--id ID ...] [--responsible ID --project ID --status STATUS --due-before ISO8601] [--where JSON | --where-file PATH|-] [--select FIELD ... --order FIELD:asc|desc ... --limit N | --all] [--max-scan N]
commands.note: REST filter только id. --where выполняется локально по явно выбранным полям; полнота требует обхода всех доступных задач. --limit ограничивает выход, --max-scan число просмотренных, это разные значения. --responsible/--project/--status/--due-before — локальные predicates; --id — единственный server filter. --where/--where-file — альтернативный advanced режим локального фильтра, без смешивания с удобными predicates. --limit и --all взаимоисключающие.
commands.mvp_reason: Retained under consideration after explicit exclusions; all existing API and lifecycle gates still apply.

commands.name: task:find
commands.note: Поиск буквальной подстроки только в title, без учёта регистра Unicode; непустой --title обязателен, пробелы по краям запроса убираются. V3 filter поддерживает только id: выбрать id/title и локально проверить все страницы доступных задач в scan budget, без legacy fallback. --limit50/--all ограничивают вывод, --max-scan10000 — просмотр; cap/ошибка/нет title => partial, exit3; полный пустой результат => exit0. Порядок id ASC; regex/wildcards/fuzzy не поддерживаются. Результат всегда список id/title: human таблица, plain TSV, JSON data.items array, включая 0/1 совпадение; карточка не открывается автоматически.
commands.mvp_reason: Explicit user addition to MVP on 2026-10-09; documented REST3 list with bounded local title search.

mvp_scope.status: 30 MVP commands and 29 post-MVP commands agreed; selected legacy admissions approved; dedicated subtask command removed; runtime acceptance pending
mvp_scope.note: Release scope is separate from existing candidate/deferred API-route classification; no runtime implementation or full JTBD acceptance is implied.
mvp_scope.result_scope_note: All five result commands and all seven lifecycle commands are post-MVP; task:file:attach remains a candidate. Chat messages/files are not native task results. Future lifecycle admission preserves requireResult and cannot introduce hidden result creation or bypass its gates.

legacy_api_exceptions.note: Explicitly approved by user: four time entry, eight checklist/root/item and two participants/history commands. Admission is limited to their command routes and documented preflight steps; participants update is limited to its two roles. No automatic fallback, unrestricted legacy fields or task lifecycle transitions.

mvp_scope.checklist_scope_note: Two root and six item operations are included in MVP through explicit REST1 routes. Root PARENT_ID=0 and item parent semantics remain distinct; task/ID/rights checks and SDK PARENT_ID gap are preserved. Item complete/renew never performs an excluded task lifecycle transition.
mvp_scope.lifecycle_scope_note: All seven transitions are post-MVP. MVP excludes status changes through task:update --fields/--fields-file, aliases and implicit steps. Reading status and ordinary task field updates remain available; needsControl/requireResult/rights/side effects must be verified before future lifecycle admission.
mvp_scope.participants_history_scope_note: Both selected commands are MVP candidates through explicit REST1 routes. Participants set changes only the supplied accomplice/auditor role sets; omission preserves a role and explicit clear empties it. The shared update method does not admit task lifecycle/raw status. History reads task changes separately from chat; rights and output completeness require runtime acceptance.
mvp_scope.subtask_scope_note: Only the dedicated task:subtask:add command is removed. Ordinary task:add may accept explicitly supplied parentId through advanced writable fields; no parent is selected implicitly and no subtask alias is registered. This interpretation is an assumption awaiting optional user clarification.
